observation.command:
COOKIE=/tmp/op_cookies.txt
echo "=== /my/account redirect ==="
curl -sI -b $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/my/account | grep -i location
echo "=== follow redirect chain for / ==="
curl -s -b $COOKIE -L -o /tmp/final.html -w "final HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n" http://localhost:8080/
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/final.html | head -1
echo "=== set a fresh admin password via rails runner ==="
docker exec openproject bash -c 'cd /app && bundle exec rails runner "User.where(login: %q(admin)).first.update!(password: %q(AdminPass12345!), password_confirmation: %q(AdminPass12345!))" 2>&1 | tail -5'
